review.tagline: Pretrained time-series foundation model for zero-shot forecasting from Google Research
review.summary: TimesFM is a pretrained decoder-only model for time-series forecasting, installed as a Python package with PyTorch or MLX (Apple silicon) backends. Version 3.0 forecasts univariate and multivariate series with past-only and past-and-future covariates, returning point forecasts plus nine quantiles (0.1 to 0.9). The code is Apache-2.0, but 3.0 weights carry a non-commercial license.
review.audience: Engineers and researchers forecasting time series without per-task training
strengths: Zero-shot forecasting of univariate and multivariate series with past-only and future covariates
Returns point forecast plus 9 quantiles (0.1 to 0.9) per step
MLX backend runs 3.0 on Apple silicon without PyTorch, numerically matched to PyTorch
Includes LoRA fine-tuning example (HF Transformers + PEFT), unit tests and an agent SKILL.md
weaknesses: TimesFM 3.0 weights are non-commercial and non-production; commercial use only via Google Cloud services
Not an officially supported Google product
Forecasting only; contexts beyond 15,360 points are truncated to the most recent
README code imports differ between 3.0 examples and the PyPI 2.0.2 note, which is unclear
needs: Needs PyTorch or MLX, Hugging Face checkpoints
Models: TimesFM 3.0 (PyTorch checkpoint), TimesFM 2.5 (200M params, 16k context), TimesFM 1.0 and 2.0 (v1 archive)
